  blob at freeze>, rev=<a strict ancestor of the freeze commit>, command naming the counter, last
  line `EXIT=1`.

- forgery-rev-at-freeze refuse CONTROL-REV-NOT-BEFORE-FREEZE: rev = the freeze commit itself.
- forgery-rev-missing refuse CONTROL-REV-MISSING: no `rev=` line.
- forgery-command-other refuse CONTROL-COMMAND-MISMATCH: command names another tool.

your delivery dir as a small self-contained builder script `build-matrix.py` plus the generated

both are refused by the runner's own expectation check.
